Name: Shiko Revived
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
I have done it. I was able to reach [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3732]Shiko's[/url] author and get permission to update! I've had a personal update done forever but I can finally release it. Credit for the original mod goes to Papaya. Seasonal outfits and sprites are edits of the base outfit done by me. Beach portraits and sprites were done by Eli0630. Spanish translation done by Rupnan. Some fixes and mod cleanup done by bezajel. Various dialogue fixes by Marlfox.

There's a new face in town and her name is Shiko Takahashi. She's a retired model who has decided to move from Zuzu City to Pelican Town in hopes to experience a simpler kind of lifestyle.

Shiko has been fully updated to 1.6 format. This version also gives her an actual room in the saloon using EmpressKimi's new [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47209]Saloon Attic and Basement[/url] (she's in the top left corner room) and optional seasonal outfits. Shiko has full dialogue, a schedule, and 2, 4, 6, 8,10, and 14 heart events. 

[u]Heart Event Guide:[/u]

2 hearts: Go to the beach on a sunny morning between 6:30 am and 10 am
4 hearts: Go to the forest on a sunny day between 8 am and 1 pm
6 hearts: Go to the Saloon between 8 pm and midnight
8 hearts: Go to town on a rainy day between 9 pm and midnight
10 hearts: Go to the farm between 8 pm and midnight on a sunny day
14 hearts: Enter the farmhouse between 10 am and 5 pm on a rainy day

Gift tastes:
-Love: ruby, prismatic shard, maki roll, salad, pearl, beer, wine, red plate
-Like: pancakes, cookies, rhubarb pie, blueberry tart, fish stew, fruits, most forage
-Dislike: minerals, most gems, most cooking, wild plum, truffle oil, strange bun
-Hate: pickles, clay


[size=4][b]***a note: permissions for this mod have been fully passed along to me from Papaya, so if you want to do anything for this mod (like new portraits, etc) you can ask me[/b][/size]

If it's questionable, best ask me. Otherwise feel free to make new looks for her without the need to ask[/b][/size]


Enjoy!
